Assessment: a temperature rose from 6 °C to 13 °C, then fell by 4 °C. Final temperature?
Highest temperature?
Big question: what story does a line graph tell?
questions.a: How something changes over time: when it rises, falls and peaks

questions.q: Which scale for data up to 18?
Big question: how do we choose a good scale?
questions.a: Fit the biggest value and use equal steps that are easy to read

questions.q: Total pupils?
Big question: how can one table answer lots of questions?
questions.a: Rows and columns group the data two ways, with totals for each

questions.q: 15:40 in 12-hour time?
Big question: how long is the journey, and which bus?
questions.a: Count on from the start time to the end time; pick the bus that arrives before you need to be there
